title: When comparison keeps stealing steadiness in the day as it is
issueStatement: The mind keeps measuring worth and direction against other people. The pressure is not abstract anymore; it is meeting the ordinary shape of the day.
centralInsight: Gurbani returns dignity to remembrance, contentment, and the work in front of you. Gurbani refuses to treat the ordinary day as spiritually irrelevant.
practicalReflection: The hardest field is the inner field. Win there first. Bring the mind back from the other person to the state of your own heart.
actionPrompt: Bring the mind back from the other person to the state of your own heart. Keep the response small enough to survive an ordinary day.
